items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: I’ve recorded four duets with him. Actually the fourth duet is the song. He sent me the song to write the lyrics to and then we recorded this duet for this album.

ctx.x: It’s for an Ivan Lins tune. And I idolize him. His music means everything to me. I sing so many of his tunes. I’ve recorded four duets with him. Actually the fourth duet is the song. He sent me the song to write the lyrics to and then we recorded this duet for this album. I’m not sure if it’s out yet. I don’t know what the album is called. I don’t know if it’s going to be released in the States.
